text:
𝗪𝗘𝗟𝗟𝗜𝗡𝗚𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝗗𝗘𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗗𝗦! 🇮🇳

India lead NZ 2-0 after Tilak Varma's 51* off 26 and a 69-run unbroken stand with Nitish Reddy.

3rd T20I: Tue, 12:30 PM IST. 3-0 on the cards? 🏏

#Cricket #INDvNZ

facebook.caption:
𝗪𝗘𝗟𝗟𝗜𝗡𝗚𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝗠𝗘𝗜𝗡 𝗕𝗔𝗔𝗗𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗛 𝗕𝗔𝗡𝗡𝗘𝗚𝗔 𝗜𝗡𝗗𝗜𝗔? 🇮🇳

👉 India NZ se 2-0 aage
👉 Tilak Varma ke 51* (26 gend) aur Nitish Reddy ke saath 69 run ki naabad saajhedari ne game 2 jitaya
👉 Santner ke 4/21 bhi kaam nahi aaye
👉 3rd T20I: Mangalvaar, 12:30 PM IST, Wellington

Kya India 3-0 karegi? Comment karo 👇
